assets.name: canon-sample-day-1600-avif
assets.alt: Etched scientific instrument with a round glass window, on a brass plinth, on cream parchment.
assets.notes: Grand Test Bench canon sample (day). Generated with flux2-klein-4b from canon.toml entry sample-day-s1101 (seed 1101), finished by finish.py --lens 828,522,200 --mirror (mirrored so the contact shadow falls to the lower right; paper mapped to #f4f0ea; lens snapped to the canon window). Viewer: circle inscribed in the viewer box; clip the live canvas with border-radius: 50%. Plate ground equals --bench-c-parchment.
